0.why: PLC.cpp:71 sets this output's channel count from the menu setting; PLC.cpp:69 writes each knob to its channel

comment: The knobs are written to the output once every 64 samples, PLC.cpp:32 and PLC.cpp:66, so a knob turned by an automation moves the output in steps of that size. Changing the range in the menu keeps each knob's value where it already is if it still fits, PLC.cpp:105-112. The keyboard copy at PLC.cpp:152-164 also reads a module whose slug is Sink, from another maker, when one is placed immediately to the left, on the s key.
